system.description:
The High Elven school of Myllnoris, where illusion is the purest art: creation through perception.

  • Sharpened Perception: when Eye for the False lets you see through an illusion, allies within 30ft of you see through it too.
    • 9th level: allies within 10ft of you also have Advantage on saves against illusions.
  • Art of Illusion: Advantage on Performance checks that use illusion as the medium.
